dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Predominantly irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures consisting of off-white high-contrast perimeters surrounding darker interiors, exhibiting sharp gradient transitions particularly along the central lateral axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, low-intensity (dark) asymmetrical clusters concentrated in the mid-section, forming a reticulated or honeycomb-like distribution against the lighter background fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the most prominent central macro-annuli form a series of irregular, interlocking triangles and a central quadrilateral, defining a non-linear geometric cluster on the animal's flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, solid high-intensity white patch located on the ventral-posterior edge of the visible hind flipper, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark pigment.
